page.layout: One page of text, one column, centred; running head at the top with page number 367 at the right; below the text the word FINIS in spaced capitals with a printer's ornament beside it.

main_text.p: gratia, diligenter ad ea attendendum eft, quæ panis Eucharistici Transubstantiationem, Purgatorium, auctoritatem Papæ Monarchicam consequuntur; & cùm ea probè animadverteris considerandum eft, an Veteres legenti vel omnia, vel quædam certè occurrant. Nam si nulla apud eos extent, argumentum eft invictum ea dogmata, ex quibus hæc nascuntur, nullo, tum temporis, loco fuisse. Sed non est nostri instituti fusiùs ista persequi. Alii non pauci abundè præstiterunt. Neque ex his quæ hactenus disputavimus difficile est intelligere, quo modo, quave methodo, vel quo fructu legenda sanctorum Patrum scripta putemus.
main_text.head: FINIS.

page.notes: Printer's ornament (decorative fleuron) below FINIS, not transcribed. Page is slightly stained; words are legible as given. The word "Patrum" closing the paragraph is printed as "Patrum" in the scan's line "fanctorum Patrum".
